formulas.description: Formula determines the Grant Opportunity Name based on various values from the Anonymous, Audacious? and Grant Focus fields. If the Account on the Opportunity is NOT a Person Account, then use Account.Name in the naming convention.
formulas.name: f_grantOpportunityName
formulas.expression:
IF( AND( {!$Record.Anonymous__c} = true , {!$Record.Audacious__c} = true , NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Grant_Focus__c}))), {!f_AccountName} & "-" & "Anonymous" & "-" & TEXT(YEAR({!$Record.CloseDate})) & "-" & TEXT(YEAR({!$Record.End_Date__c}))& "-" & "Audacious" & "-" & {!$Record.Grant_Focus__c},
IF( AND( {!$Record.Anonymous__c} = true , {!$Record.Audacious__c} = true , ISBLANK({!$Record.Grant_Focus__c})), {!f_AccountName} & "-" & "Anonymous" & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.CloseDate} )) & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.End_Date__c} ))& "-" & "Audacious",
IF( AND( {!$Record.Anonymous__c} = true , {!$Record.Audacious__c} = false , NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Grant_Focus__c}))), {!f_AccountName} & "-" & "Anonymous" & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.CloseDate} )) & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.End_Date__c} ))& "-" & {!$Record.Grant_Focus__c},
IF( AND( {!$Record.Anonymous__c} = false , {!$Record.Audacious__c} = true , NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Grant_Focus__c}))), {!f_AccountName} & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.CloseDate} )) & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.End_Date__c} ))& "-" & "Audacious" & "-" & {!$Record.Grant_Focus__c},
IF( AND( {!$Record.Anonymous__c} = false , {!$Record.Audacious__c} = false , ISBLANK({!$Record.Grant_Focus__c})), {!f_AccountName} & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.CloseDate} )) & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.End_Date__c} )),
IF( AND( {!$Record.Anonymous__c} = false , {!$Record.Audacious__c} = false , NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Grant_Focus__c}))), {!f_AccountName} & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.CloseDate} )) & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.End_Date__c} ))& "-" & {!$Record.Grant_Focus__c},
IF( AND( {!$Record.Anonymous__c} = false , {!$Record.Audacious__c} = true , ISBLANK({!$Record.Grant_Focus__c})), {!f_AccountName} & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.CloseDate} )) & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.End_Date__c} ))& "-" & "Audacious" ,
{!f_AccountName} & "-" & "Anonymous"& "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.CloseDate} )) & "-" & TEXT(YEAR( {!$Record.End_Date__c} )) ) ) ) ) ) ) )

formulas.description: Arkus (BL) 03/20/2025 conditional if it's a person account (since it uses contact first and last name) vs account name for non-person accounts
formulas.name: fxT_AccountName

formulas.description:
Note from Caroline Shenoy (1AF) on 3-20-2025:
For opportunities in pipeline (all Stages except Closed/Won), I use the following naming convention: [Investor/Intermediary name] - Type (new relationship) - NOTES
For opportunities that are meant to represent open notes or renewals (Stage=Closed/Won), I use the following naming convention: Note ## - Intermediary (if any) - Investor - Year - "NOTES"
formulas.name: fxT_OpportunityNameDebt
formulas.expression: IF( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.StageName}, "Closed Won"), {!fxT_AccountName} & " - " & TEXT({!$Record.Type}) & " - NOTES", {!$Record.Note_Number__c} &" - " & {!fxT_AccountName} & " - "& {!fxT_InvestorName} &" - "& TEXT(YEAR({!$Record.CloseDate})) & " - NOTES" )
